name: Charter Communications, Inc.
description: Charter Communications operates under the Spectrum brand, providing residential and business broadband internet, video and mobile (Spectrum Mobile, an MVNO) service. On 2026-08-19, Charter closed its approximately $34.5 billion acquisition of Cox Communications and simultaneously closed an all-stock merger with Liberty Broadband Corporation (which had held a large minority equity stake in Charter), creating the largest US internet and video provider by subscriber count, serving roughly 37 million customers (Charter's prior ~31 million plus ~6 million from Cox) across 45 states. The Spectrum brand and pricing are being extended into former Cox markets starting mid-September 2026, with the combined entity expected to take the Cox Communications name within a year of closing.
